minutes.headline: Planning Board approved three ANR plans, continued two hearings, and held off on a 40B suitability review pending counsel.
minutes.summary: The board approved ANR plans for Fire Road 16, Fallula Road and Old Shirley Road, and delayed 830 Mass Ave pending the building official's view on lot width. It continued the 101 Pleasant Street subdivision and the 7-Eleven hearing, reviewed draft stormwater decisions, and held a workshop on standard conditions and annual stormwater reporting. It appointed a new Open Space member and discussed seeking town counsel's help on the Howard Street 40B site suitability request.

public_comment.topic: A board member (not the public) announced resigning from the Economic Development Committee.
A resident asked about snow storage, architectural renderings, and bonds to ensure work is completed on the 101 Pleasant Street subdivision.
A former resident urged an escrow or ironclad maintenance language so the town doesn't inherit a private road at 101 Pleasant Street.
A former planning staffer offered feedback on standard conditions and stormwater enforcement and offered to share a tracking database.

votes.motion: Approve the ANR plan for Fire Road 16.
Approve the ANR plan for 260 Fallula Road.
Approve the ANR for Old Shirley Road.
Continue the 101 Pleasant Street hearing to July 12 at 6:30.
Continue the 7-Eleven Mass Ave public hearing to July 26 at 6:30.
Approve the June 14, 2021 minutes and hearing minutes for 757 Chase Road and 150 Holmen Street.
Appoint Eric Hines to the Open Space subcommittee.
Accept the resignation of Lin Mann from the Open Space subcommittee.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved ANR plans for Fire Road 16, 260 Fallula Road and Old Shirley Road, each by a passing vote.
The 830 Mass Ave ANR was deferred to July 12 so the building official can weigh in on lot width.
The 101 Pleasant Street subdivision hearing was continued to July 12, and the 7-Eleven Mass Ave hearing to July 26.
Staff will ask town counsel to attend the July 12 or 26 meeting for a workshop on 40B, given the Howard Street site suitability request.
The board appointed Eric Hines to the Open Space subcommittee and accepted Lin Mann's resignation from it.

why_it_matters: The Howard Street 40B site suitability request, and who pays for water and sewer extensions to it, could change what gets built there and what the town is asked to carry.
Residents raised the risk of the town inheriting a private road at 101 Pleasant Street, so the conditions set at that continued hearing decide who bears future repair costs.
Stormwater maintenance and reporting conditions, and how the town funds stormwater compliance, shape costs that may reach property owners or the town budget.
watch_next: July 12 meeting: the 101 Pleasant Street hearing (applicant documents due July 6 at 4 pm), the 830 Mass Ave ANR, and the continued stormwater conditions workshop.
July 26 meeting: the continued 7-Eleven Mass Ave hearing, and possibly town counsel's 40B workshop.

Our minutes record two hearing-continuance votes (101 Pleasant Street and 7-Eleven) that the official minutes lack, and the attendee lists differ, notably Erik Torgersen and the chair/Tanner split.
